status.guardCooldown: Can return to Guard next turn

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Enemies must attack this monster first.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.desc: Ignores damage reduction, and earns a Prize when destroying a monster in Guard.

debuffImmunity.name: Immune to enemy effects
debuffImmunity.desc: No enemy effect (monster or Support) affects it: debuffs, statuses, destruction. Combat still hurts it.

combatImmunity.name: Combat immunity
combatImmunity.desc: Takes no combat damage, whether attacking or being attacked.

supportShield.name: Plating
supportShield.desc: Cannot be destroyed directly by a Support card (damage still goes through).

ignoreTaunt.name: Bypass
ignoreTaunt.desc: Can attack any monster despite Taunt.

doubleAttack.name: Double attack
doubleAttack.desc: Two attacks next turn, then one.

multiAttack.name: Multi-attack
multiAttack.desc: Can attack several times per turn.

forcedAttack.name: Forced attack
forcedAttack.desc: The monster is locked in Attack mode.

guardLock.name: Guard lock
guardLock.desc: Locked in Guard until it is attacked.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.desc: Cannot attack for N of its turns.

damageReduction.name: Damage reduction
damageReduction.desc: Damage taken is divided by a coefficient.

tempAtk.name: Temporary ATK
tempAtk.desc: ATK bonus active until the end of the turn.

countdown.name: Countdown
countdown.desc: The counter goes down at the start of each turn of the player who played the monster; at 0, the monster is destroyed and that player earns a Prize.

hatch.name: Hatching
hatch.desc: After the given number of turns, the egg leaves the field and the card of your choice from your deck is summoned in its place.

evolutionJoker.name: Evolution joker
evolutionJoker.desc: A Young Drakon of any lineage can evolve onto this monster.

instantEvolution.name: Instant evolution
instantEvolution.desc: Can evolve on the turn it is played.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc: Part of the combat damage taken is sent back to the attacker. In Guard, an attacker destroyed this way gives no Prime.

releve.name: Relief
releve.desc: Instead of paying its cost, this monster can be summoned by sending the given number of Pipou allies from your field to the graveyard; it takes the place of one of them.

combatEndure.name: Unkillable
combatEndure.desc: Takes combat damage but stays at 1 HP: combat cannot destroy it.

supportDebuffImmunity.name: Anti-Support
supportDebuffImmunity.desc: Enemy Support debuffs (freeze, lock, stat drops...) have no effect.

monsterDebuffImmunity.name: Anti-monster
monsterDebuffImmunity.desc: Burn, slow, freeze and damage effects from enemy monsters have no effect.

monsterStatusImmunity.name: Unfazed
monsterStatusImmunity.desc: Ignores enemy Taunt, takes no reflected damage, and the Zeta virus does not affect it.

rules.winValue: Be the first to take your {{count}} Prime Cards
rules.goal2: If both players take their last Prime at the same time: draw.
rules.goal3: A player who must draw from an empty deck loses.
rules.setup1: Deck: {{min}} to {{max}} cards, max {{copies}} copies per card.
rules.setup2: Prime Zone: the first {{count}} cards of the shuffled deck, face down.
rules.setup3: Starting hand: {{count}} cards. Mulligan: once, you may shuffle your hand into the deck and draw {{count}} new cards.
rules.setup4: The first player is chosen at random.
rules.monsters: Monsters: ATK / HP, archetype, cost from 0 to 3 Energy, passive or triggered effects. A monster can attack as soon as it is summoned, unless its card says otherwise.
rules.ephemeral: Single use, then discarded. Some require choosing a target monster.
rules.equipment: Attached to one of your monsters; some effects only work on a specific monster.
rules.energy1: Generate: recycle cards from your hand during the Main Phase. 1 card = 1 Energy.
rules.energy2: Without enough energy, you pay the rest by discarding cards when summoning.
rules.energy3: Reset: energy drops back to 0 at the end of the turn.
rules.atk1: One attack per turn (unless an effect says otherwise). Strikes back when attacked.
rules.atk2: If destroyed → the opponent gains 1 Prime.
rules.guard1: Can neither attack nor strike back.
rules.guard2: If destroyed → no Prime, except against a Piercing attacker.
rules.direct: Direct attack (not on turn 1) if the opponent has no monster: you gain 1 Prime and the opponent draws 1 card.
rules.primes1: Destruction: when one of your monsters is destroyed in combat or by an opposing effect, you draw 1 card.
rules.primes2: Recovery: a Prime you gain goes to your hand.
rules.primes3: Double K.O: two ATK monsters destroy each other → each player draws 1 card and takes 1 Prime.
rules.phaseStartDesc: Start-of-turn effects, then draw 1 card (turn 1 included).
rules.phaseMainDesc: Recycle for Energy, summon, play Supports, change your monsters' position.
rules.phaseBattleDesc: Attack the opposing monsters, or attack directly if the opposing board is empty.
rules.phaseEndDesc: End-of-turn effects, Energy → 0, {{limit}} cards max in hand (discard the excess).
rules.timer: 90 s per phase: when time runs out, the next phase starts automatically.
